entries.title: Hashtag limit — verification required
entries.description: This demo limits caption suggestions to five relevant hashtags. This is an unverified product assumption, not a statement of Meta policy. Verify against Meta's official announcement before launch.

entries.title: Original content comes first
entries.description: Demo guidance: favor your own footage and a distinct creative point of view. Check current recommendation eligibility in Instagram's official documentation before publishing policy guidance.

entries.title: Make every reel accessible
entries.description: Demo editorial advice: add legible captions, review automatic transcription, and keep important text away from interface overlays. This is a creative recommendation, not a guaranteed ranking factor.
